targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(created_at, $__interval) AS time,
  COUNT(*) AS queries
FROM retrieval_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(created_at, $__interval) AS time,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_time) AS p50,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_time) AS p95
FROM retrieval_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(created_at, $__interval) AS time,
    SUM(cost) AS daily_cost
  FROM retrieval_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  time,
  daily_cost,
  SUM(daily_cost) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS running_total
FROM daily
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(created_at, $__interval) AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS positive_ratio
FROM feedbacks
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  top_module,
  COUNT(*) AS queries
FROM retrieval_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND top_module IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY top_module
ORDER BY queries DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Low-confidence-retrieval rate/day
panels.description: Share of queries whose top-ranked chunk had a reranker score below 0.3 — threshold is a starting point, tune against this project's own eval score distribution (see docs/evaluation-results.md).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(created_at, $__interval) AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (retrieved_chunks->0->>'rerank_score')::float < 0.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS low_confidence_rate
FROM retrieval_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND jsonb_array_length(retrieved_chunks) > 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
